Contact Book

Keep a searchable contact book with phone, email and notes, saved in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Fill in name, phone, email and notes.
  2. Click Add Contact.
  3. Search to find someone instantly.
  4. Click Delete to remove a contact, or Export JSON for a backup.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I add a contact?

Fill in the name, phone, email and notes, then click Add Contact.

How does search work?

The search box matches name, phone, email and notes together, instantly.

Where are contacts stored?

In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

Can I back up my contacts?

Yes — click Export JSON to download all contacts as a backup file.
